dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Ash is on the at-risk list due to medical concerns. Ash is a nervous but sweet cat who was surrendered due owner unable to address their medical condition. We have assessed that Ash is having focal seizures, and the underlying cause is currently unknown. Ash may need daily maintenance with their medical condition and further follow up with outside vet care, likely including a neurology consult and advanced imaging. Ash has allowed all handling and seeks attention during their exams after he warms up to you.
dog.name: Ash
